manual_T1_T10.detail: No event-dated fundamental data used by LowVol (pure price/vol signal). MQ sibling uses quality_pit.parquet with avail_date T+90 fence -- not in scope for THIS variant (LowVol50 quarterly) but same panel; verified in Devika's D-028 self-audit.
load_all() routes HF volume through guards.fix_ist_dates before use (run_i016_cadence.py line ~82). Price/return panels are already-dated parquet (no raw intraday timestamps to convert).

build_index(): scores computed at asof<=rb using price.loc[:asof] (inclusive of rb's own close, which IS knowable at rb's close). Weights applied to the FIRST trading day AFTER rb (seg_start = tdays[tdays>rb][0]) -- no same-bar fill. Matches the 'T3 same-bar' entry noted PASS in VERDICT.md D-028 self-audit.

Daily-bar price/return panels, no pre-open auction prints in a daily-close series; the landmine only bites 1-min data (used only for VOLUME here, and only the day-level aggregate matters for the slippage multiplier, not entry price).
R.members_asof(n500, rb) resolves the most-recent of 42 PIT snapshots on/before rb every rebalance -- confirmed programmatically above (42 snapshots present, not a static list).

lowvol_scores_masked(): vol = logr.std(ddof=0) computed on win = hist[cols].tail(253) where hist = price.loc[:asof]. This is a TRAILING window ending at asof, not a full-sample stat -- correct construction. The 40%-frozen veto (frozen_frac) is also computed on the same trailing window only.
No forward-return column joined into the feature frame; vol score uses only trailing log-returns strictly before/at asof. code_scan below checks for stray .shift(-n).
Equity long-only sleeve, no options/futures settlement marks.

Full-period backtest, not a walk-forward-tuned family; the STRATEGY family trial count (6 factor-family + 2 cadence + 3 dynamic-basket = 11) is tracked honestly in the idea file and DSR/PBO below adds this grid's cells on top.

config.json records DATA_MAX=2026-01-22 and panel paths but NOT row-counts/md5 of the source parquets at build time -- if the union/return panels are silently regenerated upstream (D-029 style corrections happen in this firm, e.g. the stale_mask itself was a same-day retrofit), a re-run of this exact script could produce a silently different NAV. Recommend: snapshot row-count+max-date hash into config.json on every Gate-4-bound run (per LOOKAHEAD_CONTROLS.md standing rule).
